title: HubSpot Email Follow-Up via Audio Upload
hard_category_focus: HubSpot deal management and email outreach
breadth_reason: This script extends breadth by requiring real-time HubSpot surface verification via the user's signed-in Chrome profile, while accepting audio upload as the primary input mode.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: User must be signed into HubSpot in Chrome with an active session viewing a contact or deal record
v7_target.proof_rule: Proof must be a fresh screenshot or DOM capture of the HubSpot page with visible user identity and record details, timestamped by the public build.

primary_user_input.reason: Audio upload via /api/listen/upload ensures the ASR pipeline is tested with real user-provided audio files, covering the full speech-to-text path.

real_user_surfaces.name: HubSpot Web App
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Visible signed-in session with user email and a contact or deal record

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Browser
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome window screenshot showing HubSpot tab and user profile

moments.description: User navigates to anticipy.ai/app, signs in, and downloads the installer for their OS.
Driver verifies that the user has HubSpot open in Chrome and is signed in to a valid session.

moments.spoken_reference_text: After the partner sync with Daria, please add a follow-up note in HubSpot for the Jordan account saying I promised to send the renewal terms and ask if Friday morning works for a follow-up call. If you cannot prove the visible HubSpot record or my signed-in surface, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Each run, the stranger must generate a fresh audio file (mp3) using say command and upload it via /api/listen/upload.
moments.description: User uploads an mp3 audio file containing the spoken instruction.
Engine checks that the ASR output matches the spoken reference text and that the audio was uploaded (not pasted or mic).

acceptable_outcomes: act: Draft the email follow-up in HubSpot and show proof of the draft.
ask: Request the user to confirm the HubSpot surface if it's ambiguous.
decline: Decline to act if the signed-in HubSpot surface cannot be verified.
moments.description: Engine decides to act, ask, or decline based on surface verification.
Driver notes that alternative input modes (transcript paste, live mic) are not used and that the audio upload path is the only primary mode.

success_criteria: The user uploads an mp3 audio file via /api/listen/upload.
The ASR correctly transcribes the spoken instruction.
The engine verifies the user's signed-in HubSpot surface in Chrome.
If surface is verified, the engine drafts the follow-up email in HubSpot and provides proof (screenshot or DOM capture).
If surface is not verifiable, the engine declines with a clear reason and no draft is created.
failure_triggers: The audio file is not uploaded (e.g., transcript paste or live mic used instead).
The ASR output does not match the spoken reference text.
The HubSpot surface is not accessible (user not signed in, wrong tab, or Chrome not detected).
The proof of the HubSpot surface is stale or from a fixture (not real-time).
The engine attempts to act without verifying the surface.
